title: LinkLayer.receive can never return ReceiveError.ENCRYPTED
description: Correctness review finding (P4): LichenFrame.from_bytes rejects E=1 at python/src/lichen/link/frame.py:205-208. LinkLayer.receive catches that FrameError at link/link_layer.py:1808-1812 and returns MALFORMED, so its explicit encrypted-frame branch and ReceiveError.ENCRYPTED result at lines 1821-1836 are unreachable. This contradicts receive()'s advertised differentiated failure API and prevents callers/telemetry from classifying unsupported encrypted traffic. Preserve the normative parser rejection while mapping that specific parse failure to ENCRYPTED, or remove the impossible result/branch and document MALFORMED; add an over-air receive regression.
